notes.record_form: verify_review accepts only pending or complete, and a complete review needs every check true while a pending one cannot carry a reviewer. defects.scenario: SENTENCE spans newlines, so in a list whose items lack terminal periods "full" in one item and "removes" in the next match no-full-eviction-mechanism. A faithful rewrite fails invented-mechanism.
The full-still-renders contradiction is negation blind: "A full cache does not stop new thumbnails from rendering" fails contradicted-fact.
The cold-after-restart contradiction is negation blind: "Cached thumbnails do not persist across a restart, so the cache starts cold" fails contradicted-fact.
The universal-scope contradiction only accepts pass or valid after "every record", while present_all at line 36 accepts "meets the schema". "every record that meets the schema." fails lost-scope.

version-condition checks only that 4.2 appears. "Before version 4.2" and "In version 4.2 only" pass with no adjudication, and the review question "keep the version 4.2 condition?" does not ask for 4.2 and later.
An inferred sweep purpose ("to free space") and a sweep-frees-space mechanism pass with no adjudication. prose-exempt has no general inferred-fact question, unlike prose-scope.
An inferred destination for the rejection report ("goes to the uploader") passes with no adjudication; only the reviewer question would catch it.
The review schema has no changes-required state: a named reviewer can only be recorded as complete with every check true, which readiness treats as approval.

The exhaustive-example contradiction is negation blind: "one example, not the only reason" and "not only those with a future posted_on date" are faithful and hard-fail example-made-exhaustive.

A contradiction with no negation and a verb outside the second clause rule passes: "old thumbnails are still there afterwards" (no restart word in that clause) and "Thumbnails stay in it across restarts".
no-full-eviction-mechanism still relies on a verb list with no reviewer routing: "older ones are pushed aside" when the cache is full passes.
The posted_on sentence rule is skipped when any failure word appears, so "A future posted_on date is no reason to reject a record" passes.

notes.recommendation: Route the remaining hard contradictions through the negation cue first (any negation in the clause sends to a reviewer before a fail), give no-full-eviction-mechanism a scoped rule like cold-after-restart, send any sentence after a cold or restart statement that mentions thumbnails with still, stay, remain or keep to a reviewer, and treat a negation next to the failure word in the posted_on rule as no failure word.

normalize strips a question mark, so "The cache starts cold after a restart?" and "The importer doesn't modify records?" pass as canonical statements, and the rhetorical "The cache is warm after a restart? No, it starts cold." hard-fails as a canonical contradiction.

notes.recommendation: Route every sentence that is neither canonical faithful nor a canonical contradiction to a reviewer, whatever its topic; screen heading text as sentences, or route any heading that differs from the fixture heading; and keep the question mark in normalize so a question never matches a canonical statement or contradiction.
